scope: Native module regression; not full App, simulator UI, physical-device or TestFlight acceptance
toolchain: Apple Swift 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.30.4 clang-2100.3.30.1), Xcode-beta, macOS SDK 27
method: Recompiled current FloeAgentRuntime and FloePersistence with the Swift 6 and StrictConcurrency, InferSendableFromCaptures, NonisolatedNonsendingByDefault flags from Package.swift. Linked existing local dependency objects. Compiled unchanged selected test bodies and their mocks into a native Swift Testing runner. Commands, selected source and original failures retained privately. Full clean App CI is a separate pending gate.
cases: Active run sends current persisted Soul/profile on next tool boundary without duplicating the owned envelope
Transient retry preserves exact provider request and performs no extra personalization read
Explicit-ID checkpoint refresh preserves historical evidence and removes stale personalization
Legacy checkpoint recognizes only the app-owned leading contract
Atomic snapshot respects workspace overrides, inactive review drafts, rollback, fallback and clearing
initialFailures: Ad-hoc compile lacked Testing macro plugin search path, then linked a stale persistence object; corrected harness setup and rebuilt persistence.
First ad-hoc runtime compile omitted the manifest nonsending/concurrency flags; active-run harness exited SIGSEGV. Recompiled with matching flags; original logs retained.
Workspace fixture initially lacked its foreign-key parent; now creates an actual workspace.
Initial prompt assertion wrongly included the existing volatile runtime suffix; corrected to check the owned prefix and stable cacheable portion separately.
